summary: In the United States, Moxifloxacin has a boxed warning—the strongest safety alert from the FDA—for nerve damage, muscle and bone injury, and heart problems [3][7]. The FDA label also warns of serious issues including swollen or torn tendons, central nervous system effects, and worsening muscle weakness [7]. In addition, a small computer model, not tests on humans, gave the drug a high risk score for the liver and a low risk score for the heart [M]. Similar drugs have also had warnings or were taken off the market for heart, nerve, blood, or metabolic issues [4][5][6].
